purpose: Record the 28-root complete-index campaign after the legal cuts (dependency body-inference skip, bounded gem-load prefetch with serial bind, Arc name-only tracked-call prefilter). The 10s warm-and-cold gate was not met. Leftover bars are contract-required project TypeTracker and per-engine gem-fact clone. Do not skip project-file body inference or merge isolated engines.

accepted_cuts.dependency_body_inference_skip: SourceKind::is_dependency_source collection uses FactCollector::without_body_inference (no TypeTracker, higher-order prepare, call-expression outcomes, expression-receiver inference, or JRuby process_call_node). RBS/YARD/constructor returns remain. Project files still infer undeclared returns.
accepted_cuts.gem_load_prefetch: GEM_PRODUCT_LOAD_PREFETCH=2 independent product loads, then lockfile-ordered serial bind. This is not prefetch-during-remaining.
accepted_cuts.tracked_call_name_set: ProjectFactCollectorHost clones Arc<HashSet<String>> once per file. Ordinary names miss without a registry lock. Hits still dispatch and classify frames as separate locked operations.
accepted_cuts.persistent_cleanup_try_lock: cleanup_to_limits try-locks exclusive maintenance and skips when in-flight reservations hold the shared lease. Blocking cleanup deadlocked concurrent gem publication after 64 writes (180s ownership lock timeout).
accepted_cuts.mri_jruby_skip: build_jruby_import_provider returns (None, None) for non-JRuby; tiny MRI Gemfile roots stay Bundler+core only (products=0).

decoded_gem_ram_cache.design: BoundedSingleFlightCache::new(256 entries, 256 MiB) for decoded gem products so sibling engines avoid a second zstd+postcard of the same payload.
decoded_gem_ram_cache.reason: Retained decoded products moved two-project process peak RSS further above the fixed 1.777 GB ceiling (2.27 GB with the cache, 2.08 GB ephemeral). Completed gem products stay ephemeral single-flight. Do not restore a retained decoded-gem cache without a design that stays under the ceiling.

configuration.runtime: jruby-9.2.21.0 for server, service-b, admin, charts, show-notifier; remaining roots MRI/auto

baseline_before_cuts.note: Phase 0 on the then-current binary. First 28-root run was mostly gem miss against a stale persistent identity; second run had more hits. Two-project warm complete was historically ~14.4s median.

final_binary.source_worktree: uncommitted dependency-visitor prune, gem-load prefetch 2, tracked-call name Arc, persistent cleanup try-lock; decoded-gem RAM cache reverted to ephemeral

commands.warm_28: same command against the populated cache directory

cold_28_empty_cache.note: Empty RUBY_FAST_LSP_CACHE_DIR. This binary still had the later-reverted 256-entry decoded-gem RAM cache; in-process hits were 70/1064. Persistent gem misses 899. Java artifacts were also cold (209 misses).

warm_28_ephemeral_gem_cache.persistent_cache_state: populated from the cold run; gem and Java hits

warm_two_project_ephemeral_gem_cache.note: Fingerprints changed versus historical two-project hashes because gem/stdlib methods without RBS/YARD no longer persist inferred returns. Do not restore gem TypeTracker to keep an old fingerprint.

project_type_tracker.why_required: AGENTS / project-file-inference: TypeTracker, higher-order calls, local flow, and inferred returns must run for every project file. Unknown means proof was attempted.

isolated_engine_gem_clone.why_required: Each Gemfile root owns an isolated AnalysisEngine. instantiate() deep-clones FileFacts per consumer. Warm server product_binding 8.87s is bind into one engine after persistent hits.

outcome.next: Do not skip project bodies or merge engines. Further wall cuts need a cheaper project visitor or interned/Arc declaration blobs measured under the two-project RSS ceiling.

example_identity_note: Published workspace, symbol, and fixture identities are generic historical labels. Measurements are unchanged; retired fixture labels do not refer to the current synthetic regression.
